summary: Tiny private apartment car park beside a pool, with towers close.
reasons: Apartments 11 m away, pool beside bays

drivers.seclusion: River Plaza Apartments are 11 m away at 39 m and Southbank Apartments 14 m away; the building and its pool sit directly beside the lot.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot opening onto Dock Street; marked bays about car width, tight for a van.
drivers.traffic: Dock Street curves past with no stopping on the kerb; the Riverside Expressway lies beyond.
drivers.convention: Serves the adjoining apartment block; no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep along the outline: about 3% grade at 0 to 20 m
No Stopping Any Time signs on the adjacent kerb
Brisbane River 154 m away, ground about 11 m
sun_shade: Open asphalt in full sun; the tower shades the south-west corner in the afternoon.

best_section.where: Western bays of the small car park off Dock Street
